parties.respondent: The Branch Manager, Future Generali India Life Insurance Company Limited & Another

summary: Insurance claim repudiation due to alleged suppression of existing policies; burden of proof on insurer to establish material suppression; non-production of documentary evidence by insurer; principle of uberrimae fidei; reference to Rekhaben Rathod case; NCDRC erred in allowing revision without proof; claim validity contingent on demonstrable fraud.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCDRC judgment set aside; repudiation of claim quashed; insurance amount with interest directed to be paid.
